name: יַעֲקֹב
summary: Rebekah’s younger son is named as he emerges holding Esau’s heel. Esau later connects the name with having been supplanted. Psalms 14 and 20 use Jacob for the patriarch or the people descended from him. Matthew also names Jacob as Joseph’s father. The Peshitta also uses this name for three men in Acts 1:13: James the son of Zebedee, James the son of Alphaeus and James the father of Judas.
note: The patriarch’s TIPNR key uses his later name Israel. Genesis gives the associations with heel and supplanting without settling the historical etymology.
